integrity: The proof gives all-degree analytic arguments; bundled calculations are regression checks, not an infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit period-two Jacobi family is classified. The degree-dependent critical window tracks the nearest squared zero. title: A sharp finite-degree gap-entry threshold and Robin edge crossover for two-periodic orthogonal polynomials
